# CDP algorithm ports

The code in this directory is derived from the CDP System, Release 8
(<https://github.com/ComposersDesktop/CDP8>), revision
`28bc42c72c1a7cb0fab933acd1c433be958a787b` of 8 June 2026.

Copyright (c) 1983-2013 Trevor Wishart and Composers Desktop Project Ltd.
Modifications copyright (c) 2026 the Talas authors.

It is free software under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1
or (at your option) any later version; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Talas's
Apache-2.0 license does not cover it. [ADR-0018](../../docs/adr/0018-cdp-provider-module.md)
explains why it is kept apart.

Each port turns a CDP program's algorithm core into a processor that renders
blocks of a stream. The table names the CDP functions each port comes from
and what changed.

| Port | CDP source | Changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Echo` | `dev/modify/delay.c`: `do_delay` (mode 1), `domulti` and `domultiv` for one channel | Streams with no trailer time, so its tail plays as the stream goes on; a live Mix or Feedback plays as `domultiv`, read every 128 frames as CDP8 reads its breakpoint files; Feedback of -1 is refused, as CDP divides by one more than it. |
| `FixedFilter` | `dev/filter/filters0.c`: `do_eq_filter`; `dev/filter/fltpcon.c`: `setup_internal_eq_params`, `setup_eqfilter_coeffs`, `presence`, `shelve`, `bw2angle`, `establish_a_asq_A_F_F2_tmp`, `set_the_tvars`, `bilinear_transform`, `normalise_b0_to_one` | No tail time, so the filter rings on as the stream goes on. |
| `Phasing` | `dev/filter/filters0.c`: `allpass`, `varidelay_allpass`; `dev/filter/fltpcon.c`: `setup_internal_allpass_params_and_delaybufs`, `convert_delay_times_to_samples_and_get_maxdelay` | A live delay is read every frame, rounded to whole frames, as `varidelay_allpass` reads CDP8's breakpoint file; the delay is at most 10 s, where CDP allows half the input's duration; no tail time, so the filter rings on as the stream goes on. |
| `LohiFilter` | `dev/filter/filters0.c`: `lphp_filt_chan`, `check_float_limits` (clipping float samples, CDP's default); `dev/filter/fltprepro.c`: `setup_lphp_filter`, `establish_order_of_filter`, `calculate_filter_poles_lphp` | Plays only the last section of the cascade CDP designs, as CDP8's loop feeds every section the input and keeps the last one's output (the others leave it unchanged); no tail time; CDP's mode 2 is not ported, as it drops the result of its MIDI conversion and reads the note numbers as Hz. |
| `SweepingFilter` | `dev/filter/filters0.c`: `do_sweep_filter`, `getfrq`, `multifilter`, `check_float_limits` (clipping float samples, CDP's default); `dev/filter/fltpcon.c`: `filter_pconsistency`, `setup_internal_fltsweep_params`, `convert_phase_from_input_range_to_actual_range`, `convert_sfrq`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib1.c`: `flteq` | Live acuity, frequencies and sweep frequency are read at the start of each 128-frame block, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint files; no tail time, so the filter rings on as the stream goes on. |
| `UserBank` | `dev/filter/filters0.c`: `do_filters`, `filtering`, `check_float_limits` (clipping float samples, CDP's default); `dev/filter/ap_filter.c`: `read_filter_data`, `get_coeffs1`, `get_coeffs2`; `dev/filter/fltprepro.c`: `initialise_filter_params`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib1.c`: `get_level`, `is_dB`, `get_leveldb`, `miditohz`, `unchecked_hztomidi`, `get_word_from_string`, `is_an_empty_line_or_a_comment` | A live Q is read at the start of each 128-frame block, as CDP8's `do_qvary_filters` reads its breakpoint file; no tail time; at most 2000 bands; a pitch or amplitude that is not a finite number is refused, where CDP's range checks let NaN through. |
| `DistortOverload` | `dev/distort/distort.c`: `distort_overload`; `dev/distort/disprepro.c`: `overload_preprocess`, `make_distorter_tab` | A live depth and waveform frequency are read every 0.01 s, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint files, without CDP8's restart of that count at each buffer; the clip level holds (CDP8 keeps its first clip level even from a breakpoint file); Seed seeds `rand()`, which CDP8 never seeds for this program, so seed 1 plays as CDP8 does. |
| `DistortReform` | `dev/distort/distort.c`: `do_distort`, `distort_func`, `distort_func_crosbuf`, `sinusoid`, `end_sinusoid`, `genpulse`, `triangle`, `end_triangle`, `reset`, `exaggerate`, `do_exagg`, `do_exagg2`, `end_exagg`; `dev/distort/distortion.c`: `process_with_swapped_bufs_on_single_half_cycles`; `dev/distort/disprepro.c`: `distort_preprocess`, `gen_distort_sin_table`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib3.c`: `create_sndbufs` | Its half-cycle scan (`HalfCycleScanner.h`, with CDP8's buffer ends) is shared with Distort Multiply and Divide. Waits for each half-cycle to end, so the output lags 2047 frames and a longer half-cycle (with the zeros before it) is cut; CDP8's last half-cycle, which it leaves as it is, plays on in the stream; its buffer ends are kept, reading zero where CDP8 reads past them; Exaggerate keeps silence that crosses a buffer end, where CDP8 runs off its buffer, and writes zero where CDP8 raises a negative sample to a fractional power; a live exaggeration is read at each half-cycle's midpoint, as `get_powfac` reads CDP8's breakpoint file, except in the buffer where CDP8's file ends, which it reads a buffer behind. |
| `DistortOmit` | `dev/distort/distorto.c`: `distort_omt`, `advance_func`; `dev/distort/distortion.c`: `get_initial_phase`, `process_on_single_buf_with_phase_dependence` | Streams with no latency, as each sample's cycle is known when it arrives; a live Omit is read, rounded, as each group begins, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint file. |
| `DistortReverse` | `dev/distort/distortr.c`: `distort_rev`, `reverse_cycles`, `reverse_cycles_crosbuf`; `dev/distort/distorte.c`: `get_full_cycle`; `dev/distort/distortion.c`: `get_initial_phase`, `process_with_swapped_bufs_on_full_cycles` | Waits for each group, so the output lags 2047 frames and a longer group is cut; CDP8's last group, which it leaves as it is, plays on in the stream; a live Cycles is read, rounded, where each group starts, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint file. |
| `DistortEnvelope` | `dev/distort/distorte.c`: `distort_env`, `get_full_cycle`, `distorte_func` and its shapes, `distorte_func_crosbuf`, `read_from_user_envelope`; `dev/distort/disprepro.c`: `reset_distorte_modes`; `dev/distort/ap_distort.c`: `get_envfile_data`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib1.c`: `get_float_from_within_string`, `flteq` | Waits for each group, so the output lags 2047 frames and a longer group is cut; CDP8's last group, which it envelopes to the end of its file, plays on in the stream; an exponent of 1 plays CDP8's linear envelope, without its `-e` flag; a user envelope must start at time 0, where CDP8 otherwise reads an unset value; live cycles, trough and exponent are read where each group starts, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint files. |
| `DistortHarmonic` | `dev/distort/distorth.c`: `distorth`, `get_halfcycle`, `do_harmonic`, `do_harmonic_crosbuf`; `dev/distort/distortf.c`: `distortf`, `get_scaled_halfcycle`, `do_fractal`, `do_fractal_crosbuf`; `dev/distort/distortion.c`: `process_with_swapped_bufs_on_full_cycles_with_optional_prescale`, `prescale`; `dev/distort/ap_distort.c`: `get_harmonic_data`, `create_sndbufs_plus_cyclebuf` | Distort Harmonic and Distort Fractal wait for each cycle or group, so the output lags 2047 frames and a longer one is cut (CDP8 stops at a cycle over half a second); CDP8's last cycle or group, which it leaves as it comes in, plays on in the stream; Fractal keeps what earlier groups left in CDP8's cycle buffer, which its miniature's last index can reach; Fractal reads a live scale, rounded, and loudness where each group starts, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint files. |
| `DistortMultiply` | `dev/distort/distortm.c`: `mdistort`, `do_md`, `set_phaseswitch`, `do_multiply`, `do_cros_multiply`, `do_the_division`, `set_ratio`, `do_divide`, `do_idivide`, `getval`, `getval2`, `interpval`, `interpval2`, `get_iphase`; `dev/distort/distortion.c`: `process_with_swapped_buf_to_swapped_outbufs` | Distort Multiply and Distort Divide scan half-cycles as Distort Reform does, with CDP8's buffer ends (Divide goes on across an end until its group ends); they wait for each half-cycle or group, so the output lags 2047 frames and a longer one is cut; CDP8's last half-cycle or group, which it drops, plays on in the stream; Multiply's smoothing flag, which changes nothing once copies and pads fill each half-cycle, is not ported; a live factor is read, rounded, where each half-cycle (Multiply) or group (Divide) starts, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint file. |
| `DistortShuffle` | `dev/distort/distorts.c`: `distort_shuf`, `do_shuffle`, `do_shuffle_crosbuf`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib3.c`: `read_shuffle_data`, `get_domain_and_image`, `make_map`, `consistent_domain_and_image` | Takes only images that reorder every domain letter once, as a stream keeps its length; waits for each domain, so the output lags 2047 frames and a longer domain plays as it came in; CDP8's last domain, which it drops, plays on in the stream; skipped cycles are not ported; a live cycle count is read, rounded, where each domain starts, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint file. |
| `DistmoreDouble`, `ClipWaveset`, `QuirkWaveset` | `dev/standnew/distmore.c`: `distdouble`, `check_distmore_param_validity_and_consistency`; `dev/standnew/clip.c`: `clip` (mode 2), `check_clip_param_validity_and_consistency`; `dev/standnew/quirk.c`: `quirk` (mode 1), `quirk_param_preprocess` | Stream each waveset or half-waveset once it ends, a latency of 2047 frames; a longer one is cut there, each part taken on its own peak, where CDP8 reads its whole file; CDP8 drops the partial waveset or half-waveset at its file's end (distmore, quirk) or leaves it unclipped (clip), where the stream plays on; distmore's multipliers 2 to 4, which change each waveset's length, clip's mode 1 and quirk's mode 2, which reads the whole file's peak, are not ported. |
| `PhaseVocoder` | `dev/pv/pvoc.c`: `pvoc_process` (analysis and synthesis), `hamming`, `outfloats` (clipping), `pvoc_preprocess`; `dev/pv/ap_pvoc.c`: the window and decimation sizes; `dev/pv/mxfft.c`: `fft_`, `fftmx`, `reals_` | Streams with the latency of the analysis frames each output frame needs (and of the later frames a process that reads ahead waits for), where CDP8 reads its whole file; edits each frame in place between analysis and synthesis, as CDP8's spectral programs edit an .ana file between `pvoc anal` and `pvoc synth`, and for CDP8's two-file programs analyses a second stream in step; the synthesis window's sum of squares fuses its multiplies and adds as CDP8's build does (except over its vectorised step of one); `fft_`'s permutation space, which CDP8 sizes at zero for some transforms and writes past, holds what the permutation reaches; at some sizes (under 24 points, and others such as 34 and 66) CDP8 leaves out a last frame at the end of its file, which the stream plays; `pvoc extract`, which in this revision fails to write its output, is not ported. |
| `SpectralGain`, `SpectralGate` | `dev/spec/simple.c`: `specgain`, `speclimit`; `dev/spec/ap_simple.c`: `inner_loop`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib3.c`: `outer_loop` | Run on each frame of `PhaseVocoder`; a live gain or threshold is read at each analysis frame, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint file at each window's time. |
| `FocusExaggerate`, `FocusFold`, `FocusAccumulate`, `FocusStep` | `dev/focus/focus.c`: `specexag`, `specfold`, `do_fold`, `fold_in`, `specaccu`, `rwd_accumulate`, `specstep`, `do_specstep`; `dev/focus/ap_focus.c`: `inner_loop`, `skip_or_special_operation_on_window_zero`, `fold_preprocess`, `scale_accu_parameters`, `convert_params_for_exag`, `step_preprocess`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib3.c`: `normalise`, `setup_pitchzero` | Run on each frame of `PhaseVocoder`; live fields are read at each analysis frame, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint files at each window's time; the accumulator's frequencies start at zero, where CDP8 leaves its `malloc`ed buffer as it comes; a step is at most an hour, where CDP8's longest is its whole file. |
| `FocusFocus` | `dev/focus/focus.c`: `outer_focu_loop`, `specfocus`, `do_stable_peaks_filter`, `extract_formant_peaks`, `establish_bottom_and_top_of_filter_bands`, `do_focu_filter`, `design_filter`, `insert_new_peak_in_peaklist`, `sort_focu_peaks_by_frq`, `write_last_focu_buffers`; `dev/focus/ap_focus.c`: its preprocessing and -s; `dev/cdp2k/formantsg.c` through `SpectralEnvelope`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib3.c`: `setup_pitchzero` | Runs on each frame of `PhaseVocoder`; a live bandwidth and band frequencies are read at each analysis frame, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint files; with -s it runs through two `PhaseVocoder`s, synthesising its stability's frames later, as CDP8 scores peaks over later windows, keeping CDP8's silent first frame and one-frame delay; a stability within 0.000002 of 9 is no stability, as CDP8 takes it; CDP8 filters its last windows with its last filter at its file's end, where the stream plays on; a zero-width band from live frequencies is refused where CDP8 stops. |
| `PitchTune`, `PitchPick`, `PitchChord`, `PitchChordFormants`, `SpecBare` | `dev/pitch/pitch.c`: `spectune` and its `getnextfrq`, `specpick`, `specchord2`, `specchord` and their channel-placement helpers; `dev/pitch/ap_pitch.c`: their preprocessing, the tune template and chord transposition readers; `dev/spec/simple.c` and `ap_simple.c`: `spec bare`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib3.c`: `specbare`, `setup_pitchzero`, `get_float_from_within_string`; `dev/cdp2k/formantsg.c` through `SpectralEnvelope` | Run on each frame of `PhaseVocoder`; live tune focus, clarity, trace and bass cut, pick clarity and chord frequencies are read at each analysis frame, as CDP8 reads its breakpoint files; the data files are text fields read when they start; keep CDP8's tune trace, which tunes the even channels whose halves are loudest, its static trace of 16 and bass cut of 10 Hz taken as none, the chords' crossed band flags and their -x keeping less of the body; tune pitches so low that CDP8 hangs are refused; `SpecBare` reads a pitch array as CDP8 reads its pitch file, frame k from the array's k − 1, frames past it unpitched. |
| `getPitch`, `PitchAltHarmonics`, `PitchOctaveMove` | `dev/repitch/repitch.c`: `outer_pitch_loop`, `specpitch`, `found_pitch_1`, `found_pitch_2`, `smooth_spurious_octave_leaps`, `tidy_up_pitch_data`, `anti_noise_smoothing`, `test_glitch_forwards`, `test_glitch_backwards`, `mark_zeros_in_pitchdata`, `eliminate_blips_in_pitch_data`, `interpolate_pitch`, `do_interpolating` and their helpers; `dev/repitch/ap_repitch.c`: getpitch's preprocessing and ranges; `dev/pitch/pitch.c`: `specalt`, `specoct`; `dev/cdp2k/formantsg.c`: `extract_specenv_over_partials`, `getspecenvamp`, `is_harmonic`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib3.c`: `specbare`, `get_totalamp`, `normalise`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib1.c`: `get_channel_corresponding_to_frq` | `getPitch` runs `pvoc anal` and getpitch over a whole sound, as CDP8 makes a pitch file, with CDP8's window count for its length and its blocks of 20 windows; the pitch-file nodes run it over their pitch source sample when they start, so they match CDP8 when the Input plays that sample from its start; frames past the pitch array play unpitched where CDP8 refuses a pitch file of another length; octmove's live bass boost changes nothing, as in CDP8; reads and writes CDP8 makes past its arrays are guarded, not reproduced. |

| `SpectralWholeFile` (`renderOfflineSpectralProcess`, `renderOfflineSpectralAnalysis`, `synthesiseAnalysisFile`) | `dev/pv/pvoc.c`: `pvoc_process` (synthesis, its `IOi` blocks and NEW 2014 end test), `outfloats`, `sndwrite_header`; `dev/cdparse/cdparse.c` (frametime, duration); `dev/cdp2k/readdata.c`: `read_param_as_value_or_brkfile_and_check_range`, `get_brkpnt_data_from_file_and_test_it`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib1.c`: `value_is_numeric`, `get_float_from_within_string`, `flteq`, `set_param_ranges`; `dev/cdp2k/tklib3.c`: `force_value_at_zero_time`, `read_samps`, `allocate_single_buffer`, `allocate_double_buffer`; `dev/cdp2k/writedata.c`: `write_samps`, `write_exact_samps`; `dev/newsfsys/snd.c`: `sndseekEx`, `fgetfbufEx` | Offline: each input analysed whole, the program run over its .ana data in CDP8's 20-window buffers (emulated, bugs included), and pvoc synth played through `PhaseVocoder` with the file's frames, written block by block as pvoc synth writes them (a file of 9 windows or fewer gives no samples, as in CDP8); data and breakpoint files are given as text, read as `fgets` reads them; where CDP8 would read unwritten memory, move a negative count or seek past its file, the port refuses; at most 2^27 output analysis floats. |
